low_power_modes_summary.ahb_idle: Manager drives HTRANS=IDLE; HCLK gating is implementation-defined.
low_power_modes_summary.apb_idle: PSELx=0, PENABLE=0; PCLK can be gated by integrator.
low_power_modes_summary.apb_low_power_intent: APB explicitly designed as a low-cost, low-power peripheral bus optimized for minimal power consumption.

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning, voltage-domain crossings, power-gate sequencing, isolation cells, retention registers are deferred to SoC integration (UPF / CPF). Neither IHI 0033C nor IHI 0024C defines a power-intent layer. APB's two-cycle minimum + lack of pipelining are intentional power optimizations.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
